content.text:
All 45 tests pass with `BUILD SUCCESS`. The redesign is complete.

## Summary

I redesigned owner identity so the `customerCode` is now `<REGION>-<HASH8>` and every value derived from it followed suit.

**`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`**
- Rewrote `generateCustomerCode` to take the `Owner` and build `<REGION>-<HASH8>`:
  - `REGION` comes from a new `deriveRegion(postcode, city)` helper — postcode range first (NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099), then the city-to-region table, else `UNKNOWN`.
  - `HASH8` is the first 8 upper-case hex chars of SHA-256 over `normalizedTelephone + lastName` (telephone is already E.164-normalized at that point). The sequence-number logic is gone.
- Added a shared `shortSha256Hex(input, length)` helper and refactored `generateHouseholdId` to reuse it.
- Updated the call site and comments.

**`OwnerMapper.java`**
- `deriveLocality` now reads the region straight off the region-and-hash `customerCode` (the segment before the first hyphen), rather than recomputing from postcode/city — so locality moves onto the new identity.

The membership number (`<customerCode>-M<YY>`), its Luhn check digit, and the create audit line all already derive from `customerCode`, so they automatically pick up the new region-and-hash value. Column widths (`customer_code VARCHAR(20)`, `membership_number VARCHAR(30)`) comfortably fit the new format (max 16 / 20 chars).

All 45 acceptance tests (including the identity-focused Cp09/14/16/17/21/30/31/32) pass.
